items.title: Will McCormick (MKC) Spin Off Colman’s To Win UK Merger Approval?
items.summary: McCormick (NYSE: MKC) has proposed spinning off its Colman's brand to address UK Competition and Markets Authority concerns regarding its planned merger with Unilever Foods. The proposed divestment targets Colman's UK operations, which the CMA previously highlighted as a key overlap area in the merger review. items.title: A $1,500,000 Portfolio in McCormick, PepsiCo and Bristol Myers Squibb Pays $61,489 a Year in Dividends. Here’s What Happens if One Cuts
items.summary: Key TakeawaysA $1,500,000 portfolio split evenly across McCormick, PepsiCo and Bristol Myers Squibb pays about $61,500 a year in dividends at today’s prices, or about $5,120 a month. McCormick and Bristol Myers Squibb each paid out 55% of their free cash flow as dividends over the last twelve months, against 75% for PepsiCo.
